worldcombat.skill.lovelykiss.summary: Pulls a horrifying face and lunges across the ground to kiss the target, scaring it into sleep on the spot. It is not ranged — the user must carry its body onto the target's face, and once it connects the kiss almost always lands; only a target quicker than the user can twist away. A missed lunge leaves the user pressed up close for nothing.
worldcombat.skill.lovelykiss.use.0: Punish a target that plants itself or turns slowly
worldcombat.skill.lovelykiss.use.1: Sleep a threat that has closed in, with one lunge
worldcombat.skill.lovelykiss.use.2: Run down a lone enemy in the open
worldcombat.skill.lovelykiss.description: Lunges %1$s blocks low along an unobstructed line; inside the %2$s judgement radius it rolls a %3$s catch chance. A target no quicker than the user can hardly dodge it.
A kissed target sleeps for %1$s; while asleep it cannot act until a hit wakes it. It cannot be cast on a target that is already asleep.
worldcombat.skill.lovelykiss.leap.on: Leaping kiss: lunge ×1.35, speed ×1.25 and cooldown ×0.9, at the cost of sleep ×0.85.
worldcombat.skill.lovelykiss.leap.off: Heavy kiss: sleep ×1.25 and cooldown ×1.15, at the cost of lunge ×0.85 and +3 ticks wind-up.
worldcombat.skill.lovelykiss.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.lovelykiss.growth.0: From level %1$s the lunge is %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.lovelykiss.growth.1: From level %1$s the lunge is %2$s, the sleep %3$s and the catch chance %4$s.
On: lunge ×1.35, speed ×1.25, cooldown ×0.9, but sleep ×0.85 — catch runners and get in and out fast. Off (heavy): sleep ×1.25, cooldown ×1.15, lunge ×0.85, +3 ticks wind-up — press in and sleep them deep.
Beyond this distance the priority drops to 14 and the partner closes to lunge range first (it still lunges, it just will not start from across the gap); larger lets it start from farther out.
When on, a target under 40% health is raised to priority 66 so the partner rushes in to finish it off.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to lunge.
